title: Breakfast for Young Women
brief_summary: Investigators will in a crossover study test the health effects of eating a dairy-based protein-rich breakfast, isocaloric carbohydrate-rich breakfast or no breakfast in young overweight women. Determination of satiety and hunger using visual analog scores (VAS), collection of blood samples and 2x 24 hours food logs will be collected.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Body mass index \> 25
* Age 18-25 years
* Regular exercise \< 5 hour per week

Exclusion Criteria:

* illness and use of medication affecting the study outcomes
* allergy towards lactose or gluten
* weightloss/gain \>5kg the last 6 months
* dieting
* eating disorder
* pregnancy
* breast feeding
* unable to speak and understand danish
